propositions: PlanContext assembly swallows child-enumeration and per-child-fetch failures with bare except Exception, silently continuing with empty/partial children list
has_children flips to False on total enumeration failure, causing container-scoped DET checks like p5_task_dag to return trivial pass instead of reporting incompleteness
hierarchy_incomplete flag and hierarchy_incomplete_detail list must be added to PlanContext and threaded through all five finalize_verdict call sites via coverage dict
list_tickets and show_ticket calls in _assemble_context_uncached require bounded retry (2 attempts, 50ms delay) before setting hierarchy_incomplete=True on failure
finalize_verdict and drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop must return INDETERMINATE verdict when hierarchy_incomplete is true, with no relevance-exception carve-out
plan-review.yaml coach steps must pass hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail from precheck outputs via with: block so ctx.inputs receives the flags correctly
